title: Quantum Hydrogen Orbital
subtitle: Schrödinger Wavefunction Probability Density Cloud & Spherical Harmonics
description: Rigorous quantum mechanical visualization of the hydrogen atom wavefunction ψ_nlm(r, θ, φ). Renders volumetric 3D electron probability density clouds, spherical harmonics Y_l^m lobes, nodal boundary surfaces, and complex phase transitions for physics and chemistry study.
formulaCompact: P = Math.pow(r*n, l) * Math.exp(-r*2) * Math.abs(Y_lm(theta, phi))
